many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

## Grid-line interpolation of repeated markers

Observed on task-eb4a14e3, solved correctly.

Rule evidenced by the demo and test: In each row, find all occurrences of the marker color (demo/test color 2) and recolor every cell strictly between the leftmost and rightmost marker to color 3. Do the analogous operation in each column: recolor every cell strictly between the topmost and bottommost marker to 3. Preserve all marker cells. All other cells remain unchanged. Apply both row and column fills; overlaps are simply 3 unless occupied by original marker.

Demo 1 (12x7, background 1, markers 2) showed the interpolation, e.g. row 3 had 2 at both ends with intervening cells changed to 3; column-wise fills also appeared. Demo 2 (7x21, background 4, markers 8) had no two markers sharing any row or column, so output remained unchanged. This confirms the rule does not require filling when there is no repeated marker in a row/column; do not connect diagonally or extend beyond extreme markers.

Practical approach: initialize output as a copy of input; for every row/column with at least two target markers, replace only the cells between first and last marker with the fill color. Generalize colors from examples: background may differ; identify the target/fill colors from demonstrations rather than assuming fixed colors."
